_help: Writers for 'Build the acts'. Each runs a CLI agent you are already logged into; no API keys. {promptFile} is replaced by a temp file holding the full brief; without it the brief goes to stdin. Agents run in an empty temp folder. Your choice and any custom agents live in agents.local.json.

agents.name: opencode
agents.command: opencode run -f {promptFile} "Follow the brief in the attached file. Reply with only the JSON object."

agents.name: Gemini CLI
agents.command: gemini -p "Follow the brief on stdin. Reply with only the JSON object."
